source.name: Self-ratings: anaBokra (domains aligned to O*NET Abilities). Performance items: to be supplied from ICAR.
source.license: Self-rating wording: anaBokra. ICAR items are public domain but distributed on registration — the psychologist registers and selects 16 items (4 per domain: verbal, numerical/letter-number, matrix reasoning, 3D rotation).
source.notes: Until performance items are added, ability scores come from self-ratings only (basis = 'self'), which the UI should label as 'self-reported strengths'. creative and manual are self-rated only by design.
